Please research this question using your tools. You MUST conclude your final response with exactly one of the following lines: 'FINAL DECISION: YES', 'FINAL DECISION: NO', or 'FINAL DECISION: MAYBE'.

I’ll look for comparative clinical studies that directly compare failure rates across three implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) lead types, then assess whether the evidence supports a clear yes/no answer.

Search variations of 'three ICD leads', lead failure, survival, comparison, and identify exact models, study design, follow-up, failure rates/hazard ratios. Determine if such comparative study exists."}

Yes. **One PubMed study directly compared three ICD lead groups within a single cohort:** a retrospective, single-center study of 297 leads implanted at Chiba University Hospital, Japan, from March 2008 to September 2017 (PMID: **31691064**).

| Lead group | Number | Failure rate | Mean follow-up | Five-year survival |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Durata | 105 | 0.20% per patient-year | 4.8 years | 98.9% |
| Linox/LinoxSmart | 66 | 0.95% per patient-year | 6.4 years | 100% |
| Sprint Quattro | 126 | 1.84% per patient-year | 3.0 years | 87.5% |

Sprint Quattro survival was lower than Durata (log-rank *p*=0.011) and Linox/LinoxSmart (*p*=0.028); Durata and Linox/LinoxSmart did not differ significantly (*p*=0.393). The study grouped **Linox and LinoxSmart** together, so these are three lead groups, not three separately analyzed individual models. **Hazard ratios were not provided in the accessible abstract.**

Yes. A retrospective study directly compared failure rates among three ICD lead groups in 297 implants:

- **Durata:** 0.20% per patient-year; 5-year survival 98.9%
- **Linox/LinoxSmart:** 0.95% per patient-year; 5-year survival 100%
- **Sprint Quattro:** 1.84% per patient-year; 5-year survival 87.5%

Sprint Quattro had significantly worse survival than Durata (*p*=0.011) and Linox/LinoxSmart (*p*=0.028). Durata and Linox/LinoxSmart did not differ significantly (*p*=0.393). The study grouped Linox and LinoxSmart together, so it compared three lead groups rather than three individual models. **Reference: PMID 31691064.**

FINAL DECISION: YES
